Standard: The resultant chest acceleration does not exceed 20g for ejections above 8000 ft MSL. The resultant chest acceleration does not exceed 25g for ejections below 8000 ft MSL. The individual axis acceleration limits found in 9.5.1.6 also apply to this phase of ejection. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Validated simulations show chest accelerations do not exceed 20g for at altitudes greater than 8000 ft MSL. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Resultant chest accelerations are verified using full system-level dynamic ejection sled test with full-body manikins representing the intended anthropometric crew range across the escape envelope.
